fitments.heading: Fitment curation
fitments.noMatch: No matching Part. Create a new one:
fitments.step2Hint: Pick the vehicles this part belongs to. Years here pick vehicles by their production years. Fill in at least one filter: the part is attached to every matching vehicle and existing fitments are not duplicated.
fitments.notePlaceholder: Note for the customer, e.g. M Sport package only
fitments.noteHint: The note is translated at Publish. A Part with a note is confirmed by the customer.
fitments.attached_one: Created {{count}} Fitment, matching Vehicles: {{matched}}. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.attached_other: Created {{count}} Fitments, matching Vehicles: {{matched}}. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.partCreated: Part {{name}} created. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.partRenamed: Part renamed: {{name}}. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.confirmDeletePartBody: All its numbers, supplier offers and fitments go with it. This cannot be undone.
fitments.partDeleted: Part {{name}} deleted. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.confirmDeleteNumberBody: The number page leaves the site at the next publish and supplier offers for it are deleted. The part stays.
fitments.numberDeleted: Number {{number}} deleted. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.step3Hint: Conditions describe the fitting itself: dates here mean the part fits only cars built in that period.
fitments.confirmDetachTitle: Detach the part from the matching vehicles?
fitments.confirmDetachBody: Every fitment of {{name}} on a vehicle matching the filters is deleted, whatever its conditions.
fitments.detached_one: {{count}} fitment deleted. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.detached_other: {{count}} fitments deleted. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.fitmentSaved: Fitment saved. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.fitmentDeleted: Fitment deleted. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.numberAdded: Number {{number}} added. The site updates after the next publish.
fitments.lastNumberBody: A part without a number cannot be found, so its last number cannot be deleted alone. Delete the part {{name}} entirely, with its fitments and supplier offers? This cannot be undone.
fitments.quantityInvalid: Enter the quantity as a whole number from 1 to 100.
fitments.identifierTypeHint: OEM: the car maker's number, e.g. BMW 11 42 8 575 211. Manufacturer number: the number in the part brand's catalogue, e.g. Mann HU 816 x. EAN: the 8 or 13 digit barcode on the box.

conflicts.title: Fitment not saved: the part contradicts these cars' requirements
conflicts.why: If you attach it anyway, the site shows the part as fitting these cars despite the requirement. Usually the part's attributes or the chosen cars are wrong: check them. Attach only if you are sure the requirement does not apply here.

suppliers.heading: Suppliers
suppliers.importLead: An import reads a supplier's catalogue into the shop and puts its prices on the site. Press Import in the supplier's row: it runs in the background, so you can leave this page and the report stays here. Publishing does not import. The import takes only mapped categories and Brands with this supplier's spellings.
suppliers.releasedHint: Checked data is shown on the site. Check it only once the supplier has allowed it in writing: this data may come from TecDoc.

mappings.heading: Supplier categories
mappings.lead: Map the supplier's categories to our Categories. Goods in unmapped categories are not imported.
mappings.empty: Map the first category with the form below.
mappings.confirmRemoveBody: The next import skips this supplier category.

suppliers.markupSaved: {{supplier}} markup: {{markup}}%. The site updates after the next publish.
suppliers.confirmReleaseBody: Buyers see this data right away. Turn it on only with the supplier's written permission: the data may come from TecDoc.
suppliers.released: "{{kind}}" from {{supplier}} now shows on the site.
suppliers.hidden: "{{kind}}" from {{supplier}} is hidden from the site.
suppliers.importSkipped: Skipped with an unknown brand spelling: {{count}}.
suppliers.markupRequired: Enter the markup as a number from 0 to 500 with at most two decimals, for example 20 or 12.5.
suppliers.importUnreadable: Pages that could not be read, skipped and logged: {{count}}.
suppliers.importNotInScope: Pages of products the catalogue does not carry, skipped: {{count}}.
suppliers.importWithoutPrice: Without an RSD price, added with no offer: {{count}}.
suppliers.importWithoutEngineCode: Applicability rows without an engine code, fitted to no Vehicle: {{count}}.
suppliers.importWithoutCategory: Added without a Category: {{numbers}}. They wait under Parts, filtered to No category.
suppliers.importMissingFields: Not filed, a required field is missing: {{articles}}. Fill it under Parts.
suppliers.importUnanswered: AI gave no answer, kept the supplier name: {{articles}}.

off.title: Switch off the import from {{supplier}}?
off.body: Its Import button stops loading this supplier's catalogue. Offers with price and stock already loaded stay on the site. To remove them, choose Take offers off the site in the supplier's menu (the ... button in its row).
off.done: Import from {{supplier}} switched off. Its offers stay on the site until you take them off in the supplier's menu.

on.title: Switch on the import from {{supplier}}?
on.body: The next import loads this supplier's catalogue again, rows removed earlier included.

withdraw.title: Take the offers of {{supplier}} off the site?
withdraw.body_one: {{count}} offer of this supplier will be deleted and its import switched off, so an import does not bring it back. Parts, numbers and other suppliers' offers stay. The price leaves search right away and the site pages after the next publish.
withdraw.body_other: {{count}} offers of this supplier will be deleted and its import switched off, so an import does not bring them back. Parts, numbers and other suppliers' offers stay. Prices leave search right away and the site pages after the next publish.
withdraw.done_one: {{supplier}}: {{count}} offer taken off, import switched off. Site pages update after the next publish.
withdraw.done_other: {{supplier}}: {{count}} offers taken off, import switched off. Site pages update after the next publish.

suppliers.importStarted: {{supplier}}: import started. The progress and the report appear in its row.
suppliers.importArticlesFailed: Not imported because of an error: {{articles}}. Fix the cause and import again.

reports.heading: Import reports
reports.lead: The last 20 imports of a supplier, newest first.
reports.empty: This supplier has not been imported yet.

brands.heading: Brands
brands.slugHint: The slug is part of every part number page URL: lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens. A renamed slug keeps its old address as a redirect.
brands.empty: No brands yet. Add one before creating parts.
brands.created: Brand {{name}} added. The site updates after the next publish.
brands.deleted: Brand {{name}} deleted. The site updates after the next publish.
brands.confirmDeleteBody: The brand goes with its supplier spellings. A brand that has part numbers cannot be deleted.
brands.confirmSpellingBody: The next import skips this supplier's articles with this brand spelling.

vehicles.heading: Vehicles and reference data
vehicles.confirmDelete: A reference row other rows point at cannot be deleted.
vehicles.identifierFormat: BMW type code: 4 letters or digits, for example 35BG. Mercedes-Benz Baumuster: 6 digits, for example 213004.
vehicles.deleted: Deleted: {{name}}. The site updates after the next publish.
vehicles.emptyHint: Click Add to create the first one.

makeSpellings.spellingAdded: Spelling {{spelling}} added. The next import puts this supplier's cars spelled so under this make.
makeSpellings.confirmSpellingBody: The next import matches this spelling by name again, and adds a new make if no make's name matches.

merge.title: Merge {{name}}
merge.description: Its series, models, vehicles and spellings move to the make you pick, and its pages lead there. This cannot be undone.
merge.merged: {{name}} merged into {{into}}. The site updates after the next publish.

vinLookups.heading: Unresolved VINs
vinLookups.lead: Codes from VINs customers searched for that the catalogue could not narrow to one Vehicle, most frequent first. Link a BMW type code to the Vehicles it stands for, and the next customer with that VIN lands on them.
vinLookups.empty: Every VIN customers searched for was resolved.

link.title: Link code {{code}}
link.openData: Open data: {{facts}}. Check it against the Vehicles before linking.
link.noOpenData: The open data does not list this code. Decode the VIN by hand before linking.
link.hint: Tick every Vehicle the code stands for. One Vehicle resolves the VIN; several let the customer choose.
link.noVehicles: No Vehicle matches. Try fewer words, or add the Vehicle under Vehicles first.
link.more_one: {{count}} more Vehicle matches. Narrow the search to see it.
link.more_other: {{count}} more Vehicles match. Narrow the search to see them.

vinLookups.confirmDismissBody: Lookups with this code leave the list. If a customer searches such a VIN again, the code comes back.

publish.heading: Publish
publish.description: Publishing translates new catalogue texts into Serbian and English, rebuilds and deploys carlab.rs and updates search. Each step runs only after the previous one succeeds. Supplier catalogues load separately, from Import on the Suppliers page.
publish.empty: Nothing has been published yet. Press Publish to put your edits live.

knownErrors.openAiKey: The OpenAI key (OPENAI_API_KEY) is not set, so translation did not run and the later steps were skipped. This is a server setting: ask a developer to add the key.
knownErrors.dispatchToken: The site deploy token (PUBLISH_DISPATCH_TOKEN) is not set, so the site was not rebuilt and search was not updated. This is a server setting: ask a developer to add the token.
knownErrors.deployFailed: The site build or deploy on GitHub failed or was cancelled, so search was not updated and still matches the previous version of the site. The build link is in the details below: pass it to a developer and publish again.
knownErrors.deployTimedOut: The site build on GitHub did not finish in time, so search was not updated. The build may still be running: check it at the link in the details below and publish again.
knownErrors.abandoned: The run stopped reporting that it was alive, so it was marked as failed. Start it again.
knownErrors.interrupted: The server restarted while this run was going, so it did not finish. Start it again.

publish.confirmTitle: Publish your changes to the site?
publish.confirmBody: Publishing translates new texts into Serbian and English, rebuilds and deploys carlab.rs and updates search. It usually takes a few minutes; the site build sometimes takes longer. You can keep working in the admin meanwhile and follow progress on the Publish page.

supersession.heading: Supersession
supersession.intro: Mark a number that is no longer made, or name the part that replaced this one as a whole. Old numbers keep leading buyers to the current part.
supersession.markedSuperseded: Number {{number}} marked as no longer made. The site updates after the next publish.
supersession.markedCurrent: Number {{number}} is made again. The site updates after the next publish.
supersession.replacementSaved: Replacement saved. The site updates after the next publish.
supersession.replacementCleared: Replacement removed: {{part}} no longer replaces this part. The site updates after the next publish.
supersession.supersededHint: No longer made applies to one number: its maker stopped making it. The part keeps selling under its other numbers.
supersession.replacedHint: A replacement applies to the whole part with all its numbers: buyers on this part's pages are sent to the new one. Set it when the part was replaced as a whole.

categories.heading: Categories
categories.slugHint: The slug is part of the Category page URL: lower-case latin letters, digits and dashes. A renamed slug keeps its old address as a redirect.
categories.empty: No Categories yet. Add the first one to describe parts.
categories.name: Name
categories.textHint: Shown on the Category page and on every part page in it. Write in Russian; translations arrive at Publish.
categories.fieldsHint: Field and option keys never change once created. Renaming an option leaves parts intact. A field or option that parts use cannot be deleted.
categories.noFields: This Category has no fields yet.
categories.keyHint: Key: lower-case latin letters, digits and dashes.
categories.maintenanceKitHint: The car page puts one fitting part from each flagged category into the maintenance kit. A lower place puts it higher in the list.
categories.confirmDeleteOptionBody: An option picked on parts or needed by requirements cannot be deleted.
categories.confirmDeleteFieldBody: An attribute used by parts or requirements cannot be deleted.
categories.confirmDeleteCategoryBody: The category goes with its attributes. A category with parts cannot be deleted.
categories.serviceLabelPlaceholder: For example, Battery registration in the control unit
categories.serviceNotePlaceholder: For example, on BMW and Mercedes-Benz a new battery has to be registered with the control unit
categories.serviceHint: Shoppers can add the service to every part of this category in the cart. The price comes only from here, in whole dinars. Shoppers see the note on part and car pages next to the service price; leave it empty to show no note. To drop the service, clear the name and the price and save.
categories.installationHint: Shoppers can add installation at CarLab to every part of this category, charged per unit. 0 means free: shoppers see "Free installation". Leave it empty to offer no installation. A single part can set its own price or refuse installation on its attributes page.

partAttributes.heading: Part attributes
partAttributes.descriptionHint: Shown on every page of this Part. Publish translates it to Serbian and English.
partAttributes.installationInheritNone: As in the category: not offered
partAttributes.installationHint: Charged per unit. Shoppers see "Free" as "Free installation", our purchase bonus.
partAttributes.saved: Attributes saved. The site updates after the next publish.

hints.polarity: Look at the battery with its terminals towards you. Reverse: plus on the right, as on most European batteries. Normal: plus on the left.

requirements.heading: Requirements for consumables
requirements.hint: A requirement says which universal goods fit a car: oil approval, capacity, wiper length. Engine and chassis requirements apply to every car with them, and a car's own requirements add to them.
requirements.pickOwner: Choose an engine, chassis or vehicle to see and add its requirements.
requirements.added: Requirement added. The site updates after the next publish.
requirements.confirmDeleteBody: Consumables stop matching by this requirement after the next publish.
requirements.deleted: Requirement deleted. The site updates after the next publish.
requirements.boundsInverted: «From» is greater than «To». Swap the values.

codes.IN_USE: This row cannot be deleted: other catalogue data refers to it. Delete or move that data first.
codes.REQUIREMENT_IN_USE: Requirements use this characteristic or option. Delete them on the Requirements page first.
codes.SOURCE_IN_USE: This source cannot be removed: data from other sources refers to it. Delete or move that data first.
codes.UNKNOWN_BRAND: This brand does not exist. Pick a brand from the list.
codes.DUPLICATE_FITMENT: This part already fits this vehicle at that position with these conditions.
codes.REPLACEMENT_CYCLE: A part cannot be replaced so that the chain of replacements leads back to it.
codes.INVALID_ATTRIBUTES: The characteristic values do not fit the category: check required fields and options.
codes.INVALID_REQUIREMENT: The requirement does not fit the characteristic: check the options and the From and To values.
codes.DEFINITION_BREAKS_PARTS: The change would break the characteristics of parts in this category. Fix those parts first.
codes.CATALOGUE_BUSY: Another import, publish, source deletion, merge or address change is running. Wait for it to finish and try again.
codes.LAST_IDENTIFIER: This is the part's last number and a part cannot be found without one. Add another number or delete the whole part.
codes.MANUAL_SOURCE: Manually entered rows cannot be removed by source. Delete them one by one in their sections.
codes.INVALID_IMAGE: This file cannot be used: upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
codes.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The photo is over 10 MB. Make it smaller and upload it again.
codes.REQUIREMENT_CONFLICT: The part contradicts the requirements of the chosen cars.
codes.INVALID_QUOTE: This file does not fit: upload the quote as a PDF.
codes.QUOTE_TOO_LARGE: The quote is over 10 MB. Shrink the file and upload it again.
codes.ARTICLE_UNREADABLE: AI gave an unusable answer for an imported article. Run the import again.
codes.QUOTE_UNREADABLE: The quote could not be read. Try uploading it again.
codes.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The OpenAI key (OPENAI_API_KEY) is not set, so the quote cannot be read. This is a server setting: ask a developer to add the key.
codes.INVALID_BRAND: The brand name needs Latin letters or digits. Check the brand on the line.
codes.SLUG_TAKEN: This address is taken or was used before. Pick another one.
codes.SLUG_RESERVED: This address belongs to a storefront section. Pick another one.
codes.NO_SLUG: The name needs Latin letters or digits to make an address.
codes.MERGE_INTO_SELF: Pick another row to merge into.

types.invalid_data: Check the data you entered: the server did not accept it.
types.not_found: The row was not found. Reload the page.
types.not_allowed: This action is not available now.
types.conflict: The row has changed or is in use. Reload the page and try again.
types.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
types.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.

errors.unknown: The server could not complete the action. Try again.
errors.unexpectedAnswer: The server answered in an unexpected shape. Reload the page.
errors.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.

alreadyExists.brand: A brand with this name or link address already exists.
alreadyExists.brand_spelling: This supplier already has this brand spelling (case and spaces do not matter).
alreadyExists.part_identifier: This brand already has this number. One brand number belongs to one part, whatever the number type.
alreadyExists.make: A make with this name or link address already exists.
alreadyExists.series: This make already has this series.
alreadyExists.chassis: A chassis with this code already exists.
alreadyExists.vehicle_model: A model with this link address already exists.
alreadyExists.engine: An engine with this code already exists.
alreadyExists.vehicle_identifier: This code is already linked to a vehicle.
alreadyExists.category: A category with this name or link address already exists.
alreadyExists.category_field: This category already has an attribute with this key.
alreadyExists.category_field_option: This attribute already has an option with this key.
alreadyExists.supplier_category: This supplier category is already mapped.
alreadyExists.fitment: This part already fits this vehicle at this position with these conditions.
alreadyExists.requirement: This owner already has a requirement on this attribute. Change or delete it instead of adding another.
alreadyExists.supplier: A supplier with this name already exists.
alreadyExists.vehicle: This vehicle already exists: same model, engine, power, drive, market, years and steering.
alreadyExists.category_field_option_label: This attribute already has an option with this label (case does not matter).
alreadyExists.part_identifier_held: This number already belongs to the part «{{part}}». A brand number can belong to one part only: open that part or enter another number.

invalidFields.key: Key: lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens. The keys brand, in-stock and price are taken by the storefront filters.
invalidFields.year_to: The "to" year is before the "from" year. Check the years.
invalidFields.production_to: Production ends before it starts. Check the dates.
invalidFields.markup_percentage: Markup: a number from 0 to 500 with at most two decimals.
invalidFields.production_from: The production start date is not a valid date. Pick it in the calendar.
invalidFields.service_price: Service price: a whole number of RSD from 0 to 1000000.
invalidFields.ean: EAN barcode: 8 or 13 digits with a valid check digit. Check the number on the package.
invalidFields.quantity: Quantity: a whole number from 1 to 100.
invalidFields.power_kw: Power: a whole number of kW from 1 to 2000.
invalidFields.displacement_cc: Displacement: a whole number of cc from 1 to 20000.
invalidFields.slug: URL name: lowercase Latin letters and digits with hyphens between them, for example skoda-octavia.
invalidFields.cost_price: Purchase price: a number above 0 and at most 10000000 RSD.
invalidFields.stock_quantity: Stock: a whole number from 0 to 100000.
invalidFields.lead_time_days: Lead time: a whole number of days from 0 to 365.
invalidFields.availability: Enter a stock above zero or a lead time in days.
invalidFields.installation_price: Installation price: a whole number of RSD from 0 to 1000000.

errors.attributeLabel: The value of «{{label}}» does not fit: check it is filled in, picked from the options and not negative.
errors.inUseBy: This row cannot be deleted, it is referenced by: {{holders}}. Delete or move them first.
errors.sourceUsedBy: This source cannot be removed: rows of other sources depend on it ({{holders}}). Delete or move them first.
errors.sourceBlocked: This source cannot be removed: rows of other sources refer to its {{entity}}. Delete or move them first.

sources.heading: Catalogue data sources
sources.lead: How many catalogue rows came from each source. If the rights to a source are lost, its rows can be removed at once.
sources.confirmBody_one: {{count}} row will be removed. It cannot be restored.
sources.confirmBody_other: {{count}} rows will be removed. They cannot be restored.
sources.removed_one: {{source}}: {{count}} row removed. The site updates after the next publish.
sources.removed_other: {{source}}: {{count}} rows removed. The site updates after the next publish.
sources.empty: Rows appear after the first import or manual entry.
sources.confirmSupplierBody_one: {{count}} row will be removed and the import from this supplier switched off, so the next import does not bring it back. It cannot be restored.
sources.confirmSupplierBody_other: {{count}} rows will be removed and the import from this supplier switched off, so the next import does not bring them back. They cannot be restored.

translations.heading: Serbian and English translations
translations.lead: A corrected translation is kept until the Russian text changes. An empty field leaves the translation as it is.
translations.saved: Translations saved. The site updates after the next publish.
translations.nothingChanged: No translation changed, nothing to save.

common.deleted: Deleted. The site updates after the next publish.
common.saved: Saved. The site updates after the next publish.

images.categoryHint: Shown in listings in place of a part's photo when the part has none.
images.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. The first photo is the main one.
images.hintSingle: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
images.deleted: Photo deleted. The site updates after the next publish.
images.confirmDeleteBody: The photo leaves the site with the next publish. The file is deleted right away and cannot be restored.
images.wrongType: "{{name}}" cannot be used: upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
images.tooLarge: "{{name}}" is over 10 MB. Make it smaller and upload it again.
images.altPreview: Text for search engines and screen readers: "{{alt}}"
images.numberHint: A photo belongs to one number: it must show this brand's part. Equivalents have their own photos.

parts.heading: Parts
parts.lead: Search and the sitemap show only numbers with a category and at least one fitting car, equivalent or requirement (approval).

reasons.bare_number: only a brand and number: add a description, attributes, fitting cars or an equivalent

parts.sourceMissingOnly: Only parts their source no longer lists
parts.emptyHint: Change the filter or the search.

offers.heading: Offers: {{number}}
offers.lead: The storefront price is the purchase price plus the supplier markup. Imports never change or delete a manual offer.
offers.empty: This number has no offers yet. Add a manual one below to give it a storefront price.

manual.heading: Manual offer
manual.lead: Purchase price in RSD, before markup. Enter the stock, or a lead time when it is not in stock. The manual markup is set under Suppliers.

offers.saved: Manual offer saved. The site updates after the next publish.
offers.deleted: Manual offer deleted. The site updates after the next publish.
offers.confirmBody: Number {{number}} is left without a price unless it has other offers.

order.heading: CarLab order
order.paymentHint: There is no online payment: the customer pays cash when picking the order up. Medusa's payment statuses on this page (Not paid, Authorized, Pending) only mean the order was placed without prepayment.
order.name: Name

lead.pending: The lead is still on its way to the CRM. If this does not change within 15 minutes, contact the customer yourself.
lead.failing: Lead not handed to the CRM, failed attempts: {{count}}. The server retries every 10 minutes.
lead.alerted: The lead never reached the CRM after {{count}} attempts. The owner was alerted in Telegram {{time}}. Contact the customer yourself.
lead.unalerted: The lead never reached the CRM after {{count}} attempts, and the owner could not be alerted in Telegram. Contact the customer yourself.

withoutLead.title_one: {{count}} order this week did not reach the CRM as a lead:
withoutLead.title_other: {{count}} orders this week did not reach the CRM as leads:
withoutLead.hint: Until the lead exists, nobody is reminded to call the customer back. Open the order: the CarLab order block shows the contact and what went wrong.

workshopQuotes.heading: Workshop quotes
workshopQuotes.lead: Upload a workshop quote (ponuda) as a PDF: AI reads the VIN, the car and the part lines, and proposes a brand and a category for each. You get a draft: nothing reaches the catalogue until you press Create. The quote's prices are not read.
workshopQuotes.reading: Reading the quote, this can take up to a minute.
workshopQuotes.wrongType: “{{name}}” is not a PDF. Upload the quote as a PDF.
workshopQuotes.tooLarge: “{{name}}” is over 10 MB. Shrink the file and upload it again.
workshopQuotes.draftNote: Fix the lines and press Create: the parts, their numbers and their fitments on the car are added to the catalogue. Nothing has been created yet.
workshopQuotes.noVehicleHint: No catalogue car matches this VIN. The parts can still be created without fitments; to get fitments, add the car under Vehicles.
workshopQuotes.noLines: No part lines were found in the quote.
workshopQuotes.uncertainSummary_one: {{count}} line has an uncertain brand: check it before creating.
workshopQuotes.uncertainSummary_other: {{count}} lines have an uncertain brand: check them before creating.
workshopQuotes.createBlocked: To create, fill in the brand, name, number and quantity on every line.
workshopQuotes.resultNoVehicle: No catalogue car matches the VIN, so no fitments were created. Add the car under Vehicles and attach the parts under Fitments.

crawls.heading: Catalogue crawls
crawls.lead: The crawler reads a maker's site one page every few seconds and stores the pages here. The Supplier's import takes Parts from the stored pages. A full pass takes hours; you can close this page.
crawls.paused: {{supplier}}: crawl paused. The next waiting crawl starts.
crawls.waiting: The crawler reads one site at a time. This crawl starts once the running one is done or paused.
crawls.workerMissing: The crawl is waiting for the crawler, which is not running. Start the crawler on your computer.
crawls.limitLabel: Pages of {{supplier}} to crawl as a test run, empty for all
crawls.started: {{supplier}}: crawl started. Progress updates by itself.
crawls.empty: No site is switched on for crawling.

pausedReasons.blocked: The site is blocking the crawler: five pages in a row did not open even after retries. Resume later.
pausedReasons.robots_unavailable: The site's robots.txt did not open, which the rules read as no crawling. Resume later.
pausedReasons.sitemap_unavailable: The sitemap did not load. Resume later.
pausedReasons.server_errors: The site answered with a server error five times in a row. Resume later.
pausedReasons.staff: Paused by staff. Resume it to put it back in line.

slugRename.title: Address of {{name}}
slugRename.description: The old address keeps working and leads visitors here.
slugRename.label: New address
slugRename.hint: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens. An address used before cannot be taken again.
slugRename.renamed: Address changed to {{slug}}. The site updates after the next publish.
